technology_name: Endophytic Bacterial Formulation for Plant Tonic
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Soil fertility deterioration and undesirable agricultural changes caused by excessive use of synthetic compounds.
description: A plant tonic formulation comprising a consortium of three endophytic microbial strains isolated from rice plants in the Kuttanad region. The endophytes reside inside the plant, offering an eco-friendly alternative to synthetic agricultural chemicals.
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial biological crop tonics • Production of eco-friendly microbial biofertilizers • Formulation of biological disease management sprays • Cultivation and farming using green agriculture practices
